name: obvious-fix-landed

openThread.title: Missing 'disable_search: true' on Codecov upload
openThread.description: The Codecov upload step omits `disable_search: true`, which causes the action to re-scan the entire workspace and ignore the explicit `files:` list.
openThread.suggestedFix: Add `disable_search: true` to the `with:` block of the Codecov upload step.
openThread.currentCode:
131:   uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
  132:   with:
  133:     token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
  134:     files: ./coverage.xml
  135:     flags: ios
  136:     fail_ci_if_error: true
>>>137:     disable_search: true
  138:     verbose: true
  139:     working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
